# 订单保本线 Lite

订单保本线 Lite is a free offline single-SKU contribution profit calculator for
small e-commerce sellers. It estimates profit after shipped refunds, return
damage, two-way shipping, platform/payment fees, and ad cost.

Tool:
https://yaoguai-xh.github.io/order-profit-line/

Sample SKU:
https://yaoguai-xh.github.io/order-profit-line/sample-sku.html

Repository:
https://github.com/yaoguai-xh/order-profit-line

Pro status:
https://github.com/yaoguai-xh/order-profit-line/issues/1

Boundary: the tool runs in the browser and does not require login, backend,
shop connection, analytics, API keys, or data upload. Do not post shop accounts,
passwords, order details, customer data, store screenshots, supplier contracts,
or payment details in public issues.
